7. If the second or subsequent ex cadre post(s) is in a higher Level (in Pay Matrix) / Pay Scale than that of the previous ex cadre post, the pay may be fixed with reference to the pay drawn in the cadre post and if the pay so fixed happens to be less than the pay drawn in the previous ex cadre post, the difference may be allowed as personal pay to be absorbed in future increases in pay.
